prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background asset for Urban Fracture, a polished 16-bit arcade belt-scrolling beat-em-up. Extremely detailed hand-painted pixel-art, rich texture and material definition, coherent adult-human architectural scale, crisp contours, no blurry 3D render, no low-detail 8-bit shapes. Wide panoramic image approximately 3:1, ideal 2160x720. Straight side-on belt-scroller camera, subtle convincing architectural depth, horizon consistent across the whole panorama. Background structures fill upper 68 percent; continuous flat unobstructed walkable floor begins at 68 percent image height and fills bottom 32 percent. Floor recedes only gently, no stairs or gaps in the combat lane, no foreground machinery or objects hiding fighters. No characters, enemies, HUD, GO arrows, text labels, borders, watermark, panels or collage. Interior hydroelectric generating hall: vast concrete industrial building, high steel roof beams and skylights, three massive green turbine-generator housings on raised rear platforms behind safety rails, pumps, brass valves, thick steel blue pipes and cable trays, overhead service crane. Manager's office with glass windows and an attached ordinary door at rear mid-left, desk visible inside. At the far right, a prominent wide double metal exit door structurally embedded in the rear wall and accessible from the clear foreground lane. Weather-neutral soft skylight plus warm industrial lamps. Worn but maintained painted steel, wall rivets, gauges, hazard stripes on raised machinery bases, practical conduit details. Keep the lower combat floor free of railings/obstacles; walkway appears safe, solid and level.
